title: Physics-Aware Distillation of a Grid Foundation Model for Real-Time Edge Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.21833v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Grid foundation models (GridFMs) are graph transformers pretrained on a masked power-flow objective, and evaluate power flow orders of magnitude faster than an iterative solver. Their size, however, targets data-centre inference, whereas low-inertia operation increasingly asks for inference at the edge, next to the measurement, at batch size one and within a single synchrophasor (PMU) reporting frame. We distil a 20.1M-parameter, 12-layer GridFM teacher into a 0.62M-parameter, 6-layer student, a $32.5\times$ parameter reduction at half the message-passing depth, using an objective that combines the masked power-flow loss with output, physics-residual, latent-state and attention transfer. The physics-residual term, which matches the teacher's power-residual profile, has not previously been applied to typed power-grid graphs. translated_title: 面向实时边缘推理的电网基础模型物理感知蒸馏
translated_abstract: 电网基础模型（GridFM）是在掩码潮流目标上预训练的图Transformer，其潮流计算速度比迭代求解器快几个数量级。然而，其模型规模面向数据中心推理，而低惯量电力系统运行日益要求在边缘、紧邻测量装置处进行推理，且批大小为1，并在单个同步相量测量单元（PMU）报告帧内完成。我们将一个具有2010万参数、12层的GridFM教师模型蒸馏为一个62万参数、6层的学生模型，实现32.5倍的参数缩减，同时消息传递深度减半，所用训练目标将掩码潮流损失与输出、物理残差、隐状态及注意力迁移相结合。其中，物理残差项用于匹配教师模型的功率残差分布，此前尚未被应用于类型化的电网图。我们在IEEE 118节点基准电网的一个可再生能源变体上进行了评估，该电网中26台常规（同步）
tldr: 该论文提出一种结合物理残差迁移的蒸馏方法，将电网基础模型参数压缩32.5倍（从2010万降至62万参数），使潮流计算能够在边缘设备上于单个PMU报告帧内实时完成。
en_tdlr: This paper distills a grid foundation model into a 32.5x smaller student network using a physics-residual-aware distillation objective, enabling real-time power flow inference at the edge within a single PMU reporting frame.
